description: Queue an English PDF audiobook as MP3, M4B, or MP4. English-only launch: PDF files up to 10 MiB, selected narration up to 20 pages, 18,000 characters, or 20 generated minutes, and one active audio job per account. MP3/M4B cost 15 credits per generated minute; MP4 costs 20 credits per generated minute.

language.description: English language hint such as en, en-US, or en-GB. Other languages are rejected at launch.

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF file

preserve_chapters.description: Keep detected headings as audiobook chapters.

voice_id.description: Optional provider voice id, if your account supports it.

name: exactpdf_generate_audiobook
